# UI Requirements Quality Checklist: M17 Carbon Restyle

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements text covering R82–R86 and the DESIGN.md v2 component
requirements M17 builds: theme tokens, fonts, components, shell, mini calendar, screenshots and
critique.
**Created**: 2026-10-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (with [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md),
[contracts/](../contracts/))

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: standard. Audience: reviewer before implementation. Scope limited to R82–R86 and the
DESIGN.md v2 components used by pages that exist today; components owned by M12–M16 and M18 are
checked only for their tokens.

## Theme tokens (R82) — Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Does the token contract list every colour key of the DESIGN.md v2 front matter with both its light and `dark-*` value, with none missing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, contracts/theme-tokens.md]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are all tokens R82 names as new (`surface-hover`, `surface-inverse`, `on-surface-inverse`, `field`, `border-strong`, `on-surface-subtle`, `link`, `focus`, `success`, `success-bg`, `progress-*`, `calendar-*`, `nav-item-height`, `space-xxxl`) present in the contract, including those no M17 page uses? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the typography roles new in v2 (`numeral-md`, `body-emphasis`) and the changed weights (`label-md`, `label-sm` now 400) stated? [Completeness, contracts/theme-tokens.md]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are sizes stated only in DESIGN.md prose (3px rule, 2px focus ring, 1px inner ring, 12px swatch, 2px target marker, toast sizes) given token names so later milestones add none? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, research D3]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is it stated which v1-only tokens are retired (`calendar-holiday-highlight`, `calendar-today`) and in which task? [Completeness, research D5]

## Theme tokens (R82) — Clarity and Consistency

- [ ] CHK006 - Is the lifetime of the `radius-sm`/`radius-md` aliases defined precisely (value, introduced in task 2, removed in task 11), and is "gone at the end" measurable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, SC-001]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the token naming rule ("names follow DESIGN.md") consistent with the existing `-size`/`-weight` suffix pattern for typography? [Consistency, research D3]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the theme grep check named consistently (same command) in spec, quickstart, and tasks? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, quickstart §1]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is it explicit that System appearance detection (`mode`, `dark`) is unchanged, so no dark-mode behaviour requirement is reopened? [Clarity, Spec §US2-2, contracts/theme-tokens.md]

## Fonts (R83)

- [ ] CHK010 - Are the exact font files (family, two weights, TTF), their source (IBM's official release), and their location specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, research D1]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is it specified that the OFL text survives regeneration of `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.html` by the release workflow? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, research D2]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is glyph fallback for characters missing from Plex defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the requirement that fonts work independently of the working directory or install location stated, and is a way to check it defined? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, research D1]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is it defined what happens to text that asked for a weight other than 400/600 in v1? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Components (R84) — Completeness and Clarity

- [ ] CHK015 - Are idle, hover, pressed, focused, and disabled states specified for primary, secondary, danger, and GitHub buttons? [Completeness, contracts/components.md]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are the Carbon field states (idle, focus, invalid) specified with exact widths and colours, including where the error text sits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the list of places that use the danger style complete and unambiguous for pages that exist today, and is the treatment of other delete actions stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, research D10]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is "at most one danger button per panel" consistent with the Courses flow, where the ask button and the confirm button both use the danger style? [Consistency, Spec §US3-3, research D10]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are "square corners everywhere except status chips" and the fluent `CheckBox`/`Switch` limitation reconciled, or recorded as an open question? [Conflict, Spec §FR-008, plan OQ-2]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are banner requirements defined for every banner that exists (below-target and update banner), including the rule colour? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, plan OQ-1]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is selection styling for tabs and toggles defined, and is it consistent with "selection is a tonal fill plus weight 600 and a 3px blue bar"? [Consistency, research D11]
- [ ] CHK022 - Do the 40px row and 32px control sizes reconcile for rows that hold buttons (vertical inset) and for two-line rows? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, contracts/components.md ListRow]

## Shell and navigation (R84, R85)

- [ ] CHK023 - Are sidebar width, background, right border, nav order, and the Progress exclusion all stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, US4-1]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are nav item idle, hover, and active states specified with measurable values (height, padding, bar width, fill, weight)? [Measurability, Spec §US4-2]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is the appearance switch specified for both the main window and the startup error screen? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, contracts/components.md]

## Mini calendar (R84)

- [ ] CHK026 - Is the fill priority defined when one day is several kinds at once (today, selected, holiday, weekend, due)? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, research D7]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is it stated that exam weeks use the holiday fill until M15 and which legend text names it? [Consistency, Spec §US5-3, research D7]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are calendar contrast requirements in dark mode stated (day numbers in on-surface on every fill)? [Non-Functional, Spec §US5-3]

## Screenshots, critique, approval (R86, §7)

- [ ] CHK029 - Is "every page" in R86 resolved to an explicit, countable screen list, including the danger confirms and an empty state? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are the data conditions for each screenshot (scratch database, what is visible) specified so the set is reproducible? [Clarity, quickstart §3–§4]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is "high severity" and where critique findings and the human approval are recorded defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, quickstart §5]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the rule that critique fixes go into `theme.slint` or layout, never hardcoded values, stated? [Consistency, Spec §US6-2, §12.3]

## Scope, dependencies, assumptions

- [ ] CHK033 - Is "behaviour, layout structure, texts stay" stated as a requirement with a measurable check (same tests pass, no view-model change)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-018, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are the components deferred to M12–M16 and M18 listed so their absence is intentional, not a gap? [Coverage, Spec §Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is the assumption that M17 needs no T-tests consistent with constitution II and documented? [Assumption, research D13]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are accessibility requirements (accessible labels unchanged, colour never alone, focus ring on every focusable control) stated for the restyled components? [Non-Functional, Spec §US4-3, contracts/components.md]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
- Items CHK019 and CHK020 point at plan.md open questions OQ-2 and OQ-1; they can be marked once
  the human confirms the defaults.
